svg.text: Structured visual could not be rendered as a chart.

Two horizontal parallel lines labeled m (upper) and n (lower) are intersected by a slanted transversal line p. At the intersection of line p with line m, angle x is formed below line m on the left side of the transversal. At the intersection of line p with line n, angle y is formed above line n on the left side of the transversal, and angle z is formed below line n on the left side of the transversal. Angles x and y are co-interior angles (same side of the transversal, between the parallel lines), and angles y and z are supplementary (a linear pair).
